objective: Quantify the extent to which modality and fusion scores depend on recording/session-associated variation rather than same-recording attack discrimination. Diagnostic of sensitivity to recording conditioning; NOT a causal decomposition.

data.pcap_exclusion_reason: M3 is derived from modbus.jsonl in the canonical pipeline; pcap is not an input to any declared feature family.

windowing.buffer_scaling: seconds (constant across resolutions, NOT window counts)

campaign_forward.seed_role: repeated fits NESTED within campaign; never pooled as independent observations

feature_governance.vocabulary_fit: TRAIN partition only; out-of-vocabulary mass as explicit __oov
feature_governance.exclusion_reason: Modality-availability indicators are recording-availability proxies; prior work found mirror-presence perfectly predicts partition. Availability is REPORTED (spec: report missing-modality availability) but never used as a detector input.

analysis_B_support.state_vector: physical_state.csv numeric process variables (M4 raw), standardized on benign reference
analysis_B_support.caliper_units: pooled SD (Rubin convention), FROZEN before inspecting any cyber score
analysis_B_support.on_failure: STOP matched analysis; report as identified limitation with the required language
analysis_B_support.required_language: Lack of common support demonstrates that the selected recordings do not permit an operating-state-matched comparison under the stated representation. It does not establish that acquisition artifacts caused the recording difference.

analysis_C_session_probe.target: recording membership ONLY (benign-reference vs strict pre-action attack-recording windows)
analysis_C_session_probe.split: time-blocked within each recording: first 70% chronological = train, last 30% = test; NEVER shuffled
analysis_C_session_probe.permitted_conclusion: The selected feature representations contain recording-membership information under the studied split.
prohibited: a specific feature causes the recording difference

key_comparisons: individual modality vs each fusion method
analysis_D_fusion.paired_rule: identical score streams and identical negative populations for every paired comparison

analysis_E_operating.threshold_selection: FROZEN grid; no post-hoc preferred threshold
analysis_E_operating.saturation_rule: one long saturated episode must NOT be reported as independent support for multiple events

analysis_F_nulls.regime_aware_null: ONLY if Analysis B common support exists AND construction frozen before execution; otherwise report infeasible
analysis_F_nulls.conclusion: Passing supports attack-episode-envelope alignment, NOT action-specific detection.

analysis_G_supervised.precondition: verify corrected M2 features are canonical before extending
analysis_G_supervised.scope: bounded robustness diagnostic; NOT a search for the best supervised IDS

analysis_H_optional.gate: only after A-G complete and reproducible
analysis_H_optional.model: one small causal TCN on M4

acceptance_rules.A_resolution_robust: Do NOT claim resolution robustness unless direction of delta_cw AND within-recording ranking are reported for ALL feasible resolutions; infeasible resolutions reported explicitly.
acceptance_rules.no_pooling: campaign x seed cells are never pooled as independent observations
acceptance_rules.no_post_hoc_tuning: no change after observing held-out results without a NEW frozen addendum
acceptance_rules.job_complete: output checksum + registry row + verification checks must all pass

prohibited_claims: a specific feature causes the recording difference
